file.Description: C3D file, relative to the dataset root. Raw VICON marker trajectories (no gap filling), 100 Hz, mm, VICON lab frame (Z up); points ordered as the 24 released markers; gaps and markers absent from the recording are invalid points (residual -1, coordinates 0). Residuals were not exported, so every measured point carries the placeholder residual 1.0 (a positive residual marks measured data; no point is interpolated or modelled)

acq.Description: Recording within the session, in recording order (rec1, rec2, ...); one round of the reaching game (4 runs) per recording

n_frames.Description: Number of frames in the recording (100 Hz)

runs.Description: Comma-separated run indices recorded (the run-NN entity of the released files)

run_start_frames.Description: Per run in runs: 0-based frame of the recording at the run's movement start, i.e. of sample 0 of its vicon motion file (= StartFrameInRecording of its motion.json; C3D frame number = value + 1). Negative when the recording started after the movement start; n/a when the run has no VICON samples (and no vicon motion file)

run_n_frames.Description: Per run in runs: length of the run's movement window in frames (= samples of its vicon motion file); sample k of the motion file is recording frame start + k. Only frames 0 to n_frames - 1 are recorded, so a window that starts before or ends after the recording is recorded only in part; n/a when the run has no VICON samples
